title: The Birth of Jesus Christ
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child relates the joy of the shepherds (Luke 2:15-20): they hurried, found Jesus in a manger, told others and praised God.

floor.prerequisite: Knows the story of Jesus' birth.
floor.question: In which town was Jesus born?

board.do: Wait for the child to say everyone.

misconceptions.ask: What did the shepherds do after the angels left?
Who brought gold to Jesus: the shepherds or the wise men?
misconceptions.repair: Two cards: shepherds praised; wise men brought gifts.

misconceptions.ask: What did the shepherds do after seeing Jesus?
Where did the shepherds find baby Jesus?
misconceptions.repair: Show a manger: an animal feeding box.

checks.question: Where did the shepherds find Jesus?
What did they do after seeing him?

skills.key_step: The child describes the dedication of baby Jesus (Luke 2:22-38): the temple, two doves, Simeon and Anna.

board.do: Write: temple, two doves, Simeon, Anna.
Wait for the child to say held Jesus and praised God.

misconceptions.ask: Where was baby Jesus presented to the Lord?
misconceptions.repair: Show a picture of the temple. Read Luke 2:22.

misconceptions.ask: What did Mary and Joseph offer?
misconceptions.repair: Read Luke 2:24 and draw two doves.

misconceptions.ask: How old was Jesus when he was dedicated?
misconceptions.repair: Put two pictures side by side: baby Jesus and Jesus at twelve.

misconceptions.ask: Who took baby Jesus in his arms and praised God?
misconceptions.repair: Read Luke 2:28 with a name card.
